provider.description: Which model family to call. All calls are routed through OpenRouter's unified API rather than the native OpenAI/Anthropic APIs directly, so this selects the OpenRouter model-slug prefix ('<provider>/<model>').

model.description: Bare model name without a provider prefix, e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini' or 'claude-sonnet-5'. Flakegate builds the full OpenRouter slug ('<provider>/<model>') internally.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the OpenRouter API key. Never put a literal key in this file.

case.description: Exactly one of 'prompt' or 'messages' must be set; this is enforced by each language implementation rather than by this schema, so implementations can give a precise error.

prompt.description: Single-turn user prompt. Mutually exclusive with 'messages'.

messages.description: Multi-turn chat messages. Mutually exclusive with 'prompt'.

repeat.description: k — number of times to call the model for this case.

threshold.description: Minimum majority-agreement ratio required to pass.

mode.description: v1 implements 'exact' only. 'embedding' and 'llm_judge' are reserved for future releases.

extract.description: Optional regex with one capture group applied to each response before comparison, to isolate a final answer from a longer chain-of-thought preamble.
